primary_claim: In an empirical case study applying Gradient Ascent and DPO unlearning to Qwen 1.5 1.8B on the RWKU benchmark, both methods erased targeted ('Mia') knowledge (e.g. raising forget loss to -2.807 vs -2.547 retain) but caused catastrophic collateral damage to general capabilities (TriviaQA EM collapsed to 0.0 from 0.61; BBH EM dropped to 0.037 from 0.45), while residual knowledge traces remained detectable via mink++ distance metrics, undermining claims of complete/GDPR-compliant erasure.

effect.metric: TriviaQA EM / BBH EM / forget-retain loss and mink++ gap
effect.value: GA: Forget loss -2.807 vs Retain -2.547; TriviaQA EM 0.0 (forget) vs 0.61 (retain); BBH EM 0.037 (forget) vs 0.45 (retain); mink++_1.0 -0.033 (forget) vs -0.019 (retain); DPO: BBH EM 0.037 down from 0.45 baseline

contradicts_or_qualifies: claims that unlearning methods achieve GDPR-compliant 'forgetting'; the authors show residual knowledge traces persist and are surfacable via adversarial probes despite surface-level forgetting
stated_future_work: investigate combining GA with neuron-level editing to isolate memory segments
test whether high-quality preference data drastically reduces reasoning deterioration for DPO
explore automated tracking of which neurons store sensitive data
expand preference datasets for DPO to reduce unintended off-target forgetting
explore deeper interpretability to automatically map which parameters encode private data
investigate certifiable unlearning and NIST-like standardized benchmarks
limitations_stated: RWKU focuses heavily on token-level forgetting, overlooking deeper reasoning impacts
TOFU's synthetic distributions can hide real-world complexities; strong TOFU results don't guarantee real-world success
mink distance metrics confirm forgetting but fail to register catastrophic reasoning dips
quote: GA successfully raised the loss on the "Mia" dataset portion but also collapsed performance on factual retrieval (TriviaQA EM = 0.0) and reasoning tasks (BBH EM = 0.037). This underscores GA's raw power yet risky side effects.
